name: pre-edit-path-tracked-through-a-question-mark-that-matches-a-slash-is-strict
description: cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#209: a policy pattern without '**' is matched as fnmatch matches it, where '?' matches any one character, '/' included. tracked.yaml's only entry is 'notes?a.md' and no default pattern reaches notes/, so notes/a.md is tracked through that '?' alone; strict_mode.yaml's 'notes/**' then makes it strict, and A's pre-edit after peer B's commit is denied as stale, as in fixture 05. Read with the '**' grammar, where '?' never matches '/', the path is untracked and the pre-edit is admitted with a bare {ok: true}. Both backends.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: notes/a.md was updated by agent 814dac78 at <TS>. Re-read notes/a.md via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
